description: Single source of truth for the 2030B Ecosystem currencies and how P2P credits convert into them. Consumed by: (1) the 2030B P2P Pairing website, (2) every project website in the ecosystem, and (3) the admin panel. P2P credits are the *fuel* that activates and tops-up each ecosystem currency — 2030B refuses fiat, so the only path to civilization-level participation is through real human satisfaction encoded as P2P credits.

credit.name: 2030B P2P Credit
credit.description: 1 verified P2P pairing on Binance or RedotPay = 1 B30C. Credits are the universal redemption fuel for every project's native currency in the ecosystem.
credit.issuance_rule: 1 verified buy + 1 verified sell = 1 B30C (config.credits_per_pairing). Single-leg ops (Level 1) earn fractional credits per config.fees structure but never less than 0.
